service: taller-gateway
frameworkVersion: "4"

build:
  esbuild:
    bundle: true
    minify: false
    sourcemap: true
    target: node22

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'local'}
  region: us-east-1
  environment:
    STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}
    JWT_SECRET: ${ssm:/taller/${self:provider.stage}/jwt-secret, 'local-dev-secret'}
    CORS_ORIGINS: ${file(./config/config-${self:provider.stage}.json):CORS_ORIGINS}
  apiGateway:
    usagePlan:
      - freeTier:
          quota:
            limit: 10000
            period: MONTH
          throttle:
            rateLimit: 10
            burstLimit: 20
    apiKeys:
      - freeTier:
          - ${self:provider.stage}-AmazonLite-DefaultKey
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - logs:CreateLogGroup
            - logs:CreateLogStream
            - logs:PutLogEvents
          Resource: "*"

plugins:
  - serverless-localstack

custom:
  localstack:
    stages: [local]
    host: http://localhost
    edgePort: 4566
    autostart: false

functions:
  ping:
    handler: src/handlers/ping.ping
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Gateway-Ping
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: /ping
          private: true
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Date
              - X-Amz-Security-Token

  authorizer:
    handler: src/handlers/authorizer.authorizer
    name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-Authorizer

resources:
  Resources:
    MainAuthorizer:
      Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
      Properties:
        Name: taller-${self:provider.stage}-jwt-authorizer
        RestApiId: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
        Type: TOKEN
        IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
        AuthorizerUri:
          Fn::Sub: >-
            arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${AuthorizerLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
        AuthorizerResultTtlInSeconds: 300

    AuthorizerInvokePermission:
      Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
      Properties:
        FunctionName: { Fn::GetAtt: [AuthorizerLambdaFunction, Arn] }
        Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
        Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
        SourceArn:
          Fn::Sub: arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/authorizers/*

    GatewayResponseUnauthorized:
      Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
      Properties:
        RestApiId: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
        ResponseType: UNAUTHORIZED
        StatusCode: "401"
        ResponseParameters:
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Date,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

    GatewayResponseAccessDenied:
      Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
      Properties:
        RestApiId: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
        ResponseType: ACCESS_DENIED
        StatusCode: "403"
        ResponseParameters:
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Date,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

    GatewayResponseDefault4xx:
      Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
      Properties:
        RestApiId: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
        ResponseType: DEFAULT_4XX
        ResponseParameters:
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Date,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

    GatewayResponseDefault5xx:
      Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
      Properties:
        RestApiId: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
        ResponseType: DEFAULT_5XX
        ResponseParameters:
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
          gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Date,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

  Outputs:
    MainRestApiId:
      Value: { Ref: ApiGatewayRestApi }
      Export: { Name: MainRestApiId }
    MainRestApiRootResourceId:
      Value:
        Fn::GetAtt: [ApiGatewayRestApi, RootResourceId]
      Export: { Name: MainRestApiRootResourceId }
    MainAuthorizerId:
      Value: { Ref: MainAuthorizer }
      Export: { Name: MainAuthorizerId }
